<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the upfield signals are at 26.40 ppm (typical alkyl methyl) and 58.70 ppm (typical methoxy methyl). The 36.40 ppm signals are more consistent with methylene carbons, not methyls. Therefore the molecule contains two distinct CH₃ groups.</thought>
